color.$description: Light theme. Names are the public CSS variables (--bg, --accent, ...); per-site CSS relies on them.

hero.$description: The 'now' card's tint, in OKLCH: the course hue at this lightness, its chroma capped. A fixed lightness keeps every course equally quiet; mixing the raw course colour into white instead greyed it.

chroma.$description: Upper bound; a muted course keeps its own lower chroma

fade.$description: Share of the tint left at the card's bottom edge: a slight top-to-bottom fade, symmetric side to side
